map.计算相对周边离焦量(RPD)，评估近视防控镜片的离焦信号强度: Compute the relative peripheral defocus (RPD) and assess the defocus signal strength of myopia-control lenses
map.📖 查看「周边离焦信号量计算器 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Peripheral Defocus Signal Calculator User Guide"
map.相对周边离焦 RPD = 周边屈光度 − 中央屈光度（D）: Relative peripheral defocus RPD = peripheral power − central power (D)
map.RPD>0 为近视性离焦，RPD<0 为远视性离焦；结合镜片类型评估近视防控效能: RPD>0 is myopic defocus and RPD<0 is hyperopic defocus; combined with the lens type, assess myopia-control efficacy.
map.相对周边离焦 RPD = 周边屈光度 − 中心屈光度。: Relative peripheral defocus RPD = peripheral power − central power.
map.RPD > 0 (周边比中心更正/近视性离焦)：抑制眼轴增长，利于近视防控。: RPD > 0 (periphery more plus than center / myopic defocus): inhibits axial length growth, beneficial for myopia control.
map.RPD < 0 (周边远视性离焦)：促进眼轴增长，加速近视进展。: RPD < 0 (peripheral hyperopic defocus): promotes axial length growth, accelerating myopia progression.
map.周边正微透镜产生近视性离焦: Peripheral plus microlenses create myopic defocus
map.重塑周边角膜产生近视性离焦: Reshapes the peripheral cornea to create myopic defocus
map.11圈微透镜阵列持续离焦: 11 rings of microlens array for continuous defocus
map.近视性周边离焦(正RPD)是当前主流光学近视防控的核心机制，但离焦量并非越大越好: Myopic peripheral defocus (positive RPD) is the core mechanism of the current mainstream optical myopia control, but a larger defocus is not always better; visual quality must be balanced.
map.离焦信号评估基于屈光度差，实际视网膜离焦还受眼轴长度、角膜形态与镜片设计影响，防: Defocus signal assessment is based on the power difference; actual retinal defocus is also affected by axial length, corneal shape and lens design, and the control scheme must be made by an ophthalmologist/optometrist.
map.算中心与周边屈光差（RPD）判离焦类型。: Compute the central-peripheral power difference (RPD) to determine the defocus type.
map.周边近视离焦延缓眼轴。: Peripheral myopic defocus slows axial growth.
map.中心 −3.00D、偏心 20° 处周边 −2.50D → 相对周边离焦 RPD: Central −3.00D, peripheral −2.50D at 20° eccentricity → relative peripheral defocus RPD=−2.50−(−3.00)=+0.50D (periphery relatively plus = myopic defocus).
map.RPD>0（周边相对正离焦）被认为可减缓眼轴增长；普通单光片常 RPD<0（周边: RPD>0 (relatively plus peripheral defocus) is considered able to slow axial growth; ordinary single-vision lenses often have RPD<0 (peripheral hyperopic defocus) that promotes myopia.
map.周边离焦怎么控？: How does peripheral defocus control work?
map.用周边离焦设计镜片/OK 镜使周边成相对正离焦，临床证据可缓近视进展约 30%–: Using peripheral-defocus design lenses/OK lenses to make the periphery relatively plus defocus; clinical evidence shows it slows myopia progression by about 30%-60%.
map.不够。中心清但周边远视离焦会信号眼轴增长，是近年防控焦点。: No. Clear central vision but peripheral hyperopic defocus signals axial growth, the focus of myopia control in recent years.
